**#187 after-deploy reading complete** for merge `a244cb479eed70d4098e72d9d0b0a6f41d0ffda9`.

Healthy production **PID 63683**, process start **09 Nov 02:06:33 +10:00**, remained the same incarnation. Initial and post-sample pings report embedded commit `a244cb479e`, matching the resolved merge prefix; the generic version label is not source proof.

| Reading, 09 Nov +10:00 | Result |
|---|---|
| Daemon minute | **02:24:43.556906 to 02:25:43.567289**, **60.010050 monotonic seconds** |
| Recorded launches | **152 to 152: +0**, **0.000/s**; all 16 populated sites flat, with each snapshot's site sum equal to its total |
| Registrations | **12 to 12**, registration ps **17 to 17** |
| Daemon CPU | Cumulative **149.93 to 158.06 CPU seconds**: **8.13 CPU seconds**, **13.55% of one CPU** |
| RSS | **190,032 to 190,000 KiB**, **185.578 to 185.547 MiB**, **-32 KiB** |
| Separate machine sample | **02:26:24 to 02:26:44**, `just spawn-rate --seconds 20 --json`: **308.5 launches/s estimate**, **303.4/s sampled** |
| Machine attribution | **201.7/s other**, **101.7/s gone before attribution**; no recognized direct daemon children; **0.0/s recognized status-line runs** |

The sampler identified PID 63683, made **226,427 polls**, and ran after the daemon minute. It costs CPU and its attribution counts are lower bounds. Test-binary-like names appear in the machine sample, but truncated labels are not proof of their owners; the machine's high rate is not attributed to the production daemon.

The earlier setup ping was 142. Ten staged-submit launches occurred before the measured minute; **142 to 152 is not this minute's delta**. The post-sample ping remained at 152. No synthetic traffic was generated, and no local build/test, legacy replay, benchmark or bounce was performed by this seat.

This is passive deployed-state evidence, not a matched before/after causal comparison or a maximum-volume legacy-plan reconstruction test. Flat launches do not imply zero in-process work. The requested #187 reading is filed; **#189 after-deploy and joint A1+A2 AC9 remain owed later**.

Raw receipts: `pr187-after-window.json`, `pr187-after-machine.json`, `pr187-after-machine-times.txt`, `pr187-after-deploy-ping.json`.
